name: Wildlife Diversity Grant Program (2027-2029)

funder.name: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: Biennial grants for conservation and recovery actions and data collection for at-risk Washington wildlife, via a pre-proposal and invited full proposal. Habitat restoration, easements and land acquisition are not funded.

calls.label: 2027-2029 biennium pre-proposals
calls.note: Pre-proposal deadline; selected applicants are then invited to submit full proposals

status.quote: seeking pre-proposals for the Department's latest round of Wildlife Diversity Grants

opens.quote: Pre-proposal period and submission form opens Oct. 5, 2026

deadline.quote: Grant applicants must complete a pre-proposal application form no later than 11:59 p.m. on Nov. 13, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants who are affiliated with public, nonprofit, academic, or tribal entities are eligible to submit proposals.

geography.quote: Proposed projects must take place within Washington

access.quote: Grant applicants must complete a pre-proposal application form no later than 11:59 p.m. on Nov. 13, 2026.

amount.quote: Grant budgets can range from a minimum of $25,000 and a maximum of $250,000 per project.
